expedition_advisor.agent_description: Evaluates party attrition, sweeper move PP, and recommends whether to continue switch-training or execute a pit-stop.
expedition_advisor.agent_system_prompt: You are an expert expedition advisor for Generation 1 Pokémon Blue post-game training. Given party HP, status conditions, move PP, target trainee EXP, and distance to Pokémon Center, evaluate resource attrition and recommend whether to continue cavern switch-training or trigger an immediate pit-stop (Fly to Pokémon Center).
expedition_advisor.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"trainee_exp_remaining": {"type": "integer", "description": "EXP needed to next level milestone"}, "mewtwo_psychic_pp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Remaining PP for Mewtwo's Psychic"}, "mewtwo_hp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Current HP for Mewtwo"}, "blastoise_surf_pp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Remaining PP for Blastoise's Surf"}, "blastoise_hp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Current HP for Blastoise"}, "blastoise_status": {"type": "string", "description": "Status condition for Blastoise (e.g. OK, PSN)"}}, "required": ["trainee_exp_remaining", "mewtwo_psychic_pp", "mewtwo_hp", "blastoise_surf_pp", "blastoise_hp", "blastoise_status"]}
expedition_advisor.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"recommendation": {"type": "string", "enum": ["continue", "pit_stop"], "description": "Recommended action"}, "reasoning": {"type": "string", "description": "Detailed strategic justification for the recommendation"}, "estimated_battles_remaining": {"type": "integer", "description": "Estimated number of battles to reach the trainee milestone"}}, "required": ["recommendation", "reasoning", "estimated_battles_remaining"]}
